pages.title: Merging
pages.text: Merging pours ordinary potions into the tank's mundane hexbrew and converts them into drinkable witch hexbrew. The tank must hold a full bucket first, and each merge outputs exactly 250 mB: one bottle. Effects at the same level across the input bottles have their durations summed, and the fluid takes the mixed potion color.

pages.title: Splash & Enhancing
pages.text: Merging splash potions instead yields throwable witch splash, and finished witch hexbrew converts 1:1 the same way. Enhancing re-brews effect-bearing witch fluid: every stored duration doubles, up to an 8-minute cap, and maxed effects refuse further enhancing. Higher tiers merge more bottles at once; check JEI for exact inputs.
